manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the ceramic mug from the table, rotate it, place it in the middle, and hang it onto the rack with straight and slanted rods.

Task description: Turn the dark cup left of center into a pose suitable for hanging, then hang it on the middle of the white cup rack on the right, which has straight and angled rods.

Success criteria: The cup is hanging on the cup rack, horizontally near the central target area of the rack, at a clearly suspended height above the tabletop; the right gripper is open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a rim section away from the mug handle, with one finger inside and one outside and the opening matched to local wall thickness. Confirm the fingers surround the wall before closing, leaving room to thread the handle onto the rod.
- If reorienting, use the open space outside the cup stand, leaving room for the cup body and gripper to rotate and reducing the risk of brushing the straight rod.
- To mate with the angled rod, face the cup handle opening toward its free end and make small adjustments along the rod so its tip passes through the opening rather than pressing against the handle rim.
- Before releasing, lower slightly so the inside of the cup handle rests on the hanging bar. Confirm the cup is supported to avoid slipping after unsupported release.
